other_conditions: Must be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have at least 5 years of regular membership
Age must be 52 years or younger (so that 8 years remain until age 60)
Facility can be availed only once in a lifetime
Must add a minimum of 90 days work experience of the preceding year
benefits_summary: Interest‑free loan up to ₹2,00,000 for purchase or construction of a house.
